    <Component id="reactor" type="reactor"/>

  <Reagents>
    <!--r1: [K].OC(C)(C)C-->
    <Reagent name="r1" role="catalyst"/>
    <!--r2: C[OH2+].C[OH2+].C1CC=CCCC=C1.C1CC=CCCC=C1.[Ir].[Ir]-->
    <Reagent name="r2" role="catalyst"/>
    <!--r3: O=C1C=CC=2C=CC=C(C3=CN=C(C=C3)C=4N=CC=CC4)C2N1-->
    <Reagent name="r3" role="reagent"/>
    <!--r4: O1B(OC(C)(C)C1(C)C)B2OC(C)(C)C(O2)(C)C-->
    <Reagent name="r4" role="reagent"/>
    <!--r5: O1CCCC1-->
    <Reagent name="r5" role="solvent"/>
    <!--r6: O=C(C=1N=C(C=CC1)C(=O)N(C(C)C)C(C)C)N(C(C)C)C(C)C-->
    <Reagent name="r6" role="substrate"/>
  </Reagents>
  <Procedure>
    <!--Analysis context: {"pressure_control": "OPEN", "reflux": false}-->
    <!--Pressure-control context: OPEN-->
    <!--In an argon filled glove box-->
    <!--Atmosphere context (no purge operation inferred): argon; environment-->
    <!--[Ir(cod)(OMe)]2 (1.98 mg, 1.5 mol%)-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r2" amount="0.003 mmol"/>
    <!--L1 ligand (2.1 mg, 3.5 mol%)-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r3" amount="0.007 mmol"/>
    <!--B2pin2 (50.8 mg, 1.0 equiv.)-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r4" amount="0.2 mmol"/>
    <!--KOtBu (1.0 mg, 4.5 mol%)-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r1" amount="0.009 mmol"/>
    <!--dry THF (1.0 mL)-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r5" amount="1 mL"/>
    <!--The reaction mixture was stirred for 2 minutes at room temperature.-->
    <Stir vessel="reactor" time="120 s"/>
    <!--To this mixture, N2,N2,N6,N6-tetraisopropylpyridine-2,6-dicarboxamide (66.7 mg, 0.2 mmol) was added.-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r6" amount="0.2 mmol"/>
    <!--The microreactor was capped with a teflon pressure cap and placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC. The reaction mixture was stirred for 12 h.-->
    <HeatChill vessel="reactor" temp="80 °C" time="43200 s" stir="true"/>
    <!--THF was removed under reduced pressure-->
    <Evaporate vessel="reactor"/>
    <!--dried on an oil bath at 90 oC for 30 minutes-->
    <Evaporate vessel="reactor" temp="90 °C" time="1800 s"/>
  </Procedure>
</Synthesis>

  <Metadata description="Intentionally perturbed source-derived procedure; experimental outcome not observed." publication="https://chemrxiv.org/engage/chemrxiv/article-details/60c9e3f37792a23bfdb2d471" reaction_class="1.3.1 [N-arylation with Ar-X] Bromo Buchwald-Hartwig amination"/>
  <Hardware>
    <!--Analysis binding: {"component": "column", "params": {}, "verified": false, "wetted_materials": null}-->
    <Component id="column" type="column"/>
    <!--Analysis binding: {"component": "heater", "params": {"T_max_C": 310, "T_min_C": null, "rpm_max": 1500, "rpm_min": 50}, "verified": false, "wetted_materials": []}-->
    <Component id="heater" type="heater"/>
    <!--Analysis binding: {"component": "product", "params": {}, "verified": false, "wetted_materials": null}-->
    <Component id="product" type="reactor"/>
    <!--Analysis binding: {"component": "reactor", "params": {"T_max_C": null, "T_min_C": null, "capacity_mL": null, "pressure_max_bar": null}, "verified": false, "wetted_materials": null}-->
    <Component id="reactor" type="reactor"/>
  </Hardware>
  <Reagents>
    <!--r1: C(=O)([O-])[O-].[Cs+].[Cs+]-->
    <Reagent name="r1" role="reagent"/>
    <!--r2: CC1=CC=CC=C1-->
    <Reagent name="r2" role="solvent"/>
    <!--r3: CN(C)[C@H]1CCNC1-->
    <Reagent name="r3" role="substrate"/>
    <!--r4: C1=CC(=C(C=C1Cl)Br)C#N-->
    <Reagent name="r4" role="substrate"/>
    <!--r5: C1=CC=C(C=C1)P(C2=CC=CC=C2)C3=C(C4=CC=CC=C4C=C3)C5=C(C=CC6=CC=CC=C65)P(C7=CC=CC=C7)C8=CC=CC=C8-->
    <Reagent name="r5" role="catalyst"/>
    <!--r6: C1=CC=C(C=C1)/C=C/C(=O)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2.C1=CC=C(C=C1)/C=C/C(=O)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2.C1=CC=C(C=C1)/C=C/C(=O)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2.[Pd].[Pd]-->
    <Reagent name="r6" role="catalyst"/>
  </Reagents>
  <Procedure>
    <!--Analysis context: {"pressure_control": "UNKNOWN", "reflux": false}-->
    <!--2-bromo-4-chlorobenzonitrile (500 mg, 2.31 mmol)-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r4" amount="2.31 mmol"/>
    <!--(S)-N,N-dimethylpyrrolidin-3-amine (317 mg, 2.77 mmol)-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r3" amount="2.77 mmol"/>
    <!--cesium carbonate (1505 mg, 4.62 mmol)-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r1" amount="4.62 mmol"/>
    <!--BINAP (288 mg, 0.46 mmol)-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r5" amount="0.462 mmol"/>
    <!--in toluene (15 mL)-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r2" amount="15 mL"/>
    <!--was stirred at 100 °C for overnight-->
    <HeatChillToTemp vessel="reactor" temp="100 °C" stir="true"/>
    <!--Conc. in vacuo-->
    <Evaporate vessel="reactor"/>
    <!--the residue was purified with ISCO (100% ethyl acetate to 30% methanol in ethyl acetate)-->
    <RunColumn from_vessel="reactor" to_vessel="product" column="column"/>
  </Procedure>
</Synthesis>
